name: AP_CORRELATION_SEQ_ACCT_DATES
description: AP_CORRELATION_SEQ_ACCT_DATES contains the maximum accounting date of transactions with a document sequence value for each legal entity and document sequence ID combination. This information is used to improve the performance of the program that enforces the correlation of document sequence number with accounting date. As part of correlation enforcement, transactions with an earlier accounting date cannot be assigned a document sequence value for a particular legal entity if a transaction with a later accounting date for the same legal entity and document sequence ID already exists.

columns.name: MAX_ACCT_DATE
columns.description: Maximum Accounting Date for Correlation Enforcement
